objective: Split distinct definition/use webs of a reused virtual register, with independent finite inductive renaming validation before C display. Retain entry parameter IDs, exact operations/order/faults/CFG and original structural evidence.

contracts.builder: New web.rs. pub fn split(program:&Program)->Option<WebSplit>; WebSplit Clone Debug, .program()->&Program, .stats()->WebStats. WebStats Clone Copy Debug Default Eq PartialEq with pub definitions:usize, webs:usize, split_registers:usize, fresh_registers:usize. Sparse active registers, Entry definition plus unique definition per reachable Reg assignment. Reaching defs fixed point across all CFG edges, ENTRY SEED MUST remain on entry backedges. After convergence union definitions of SAME source register that reach each syntactic read; read before dest write, memory address+RHS and all lazy branches conservative, control after all assignments. Each component becomes one Reg: if entry component is actually read, retain original reg ID there; else reuse original reg ID for first used component; other used components fresh >= original count. Unread definitions may be kept original; ensure via internal checks or retain each own component if unsure. Original regs with <=1 useful web should stay exact to avoid gratuitous renaming. ALL entry read IDs stay original so caller keeps source ABI. Rewrite only Reg leaves/destinations in reachable instructions, keep all operators/constants/widths/assignment order/control kind/targets/addresses/sizes and unreachable instructions exact. No folding/copy removal/effect motion. Validate entire input including unreachable depth/count before recursive clone, bound registers/defs/blocks/state cells/total set members/work/iterations/fresh ID arithmetic; whole None fallback. No verifier dependency. Tests independently replay poisoned fresh bank normal/fault/partial memory/trace/cutoffs, entry backedges/diamonds/lazy reads/sequential assignments/unreachable and bounds.
contracts.verifier: New web_verify.rs independent of builder. pub fn validate(original:&Program,renamed:&Program)->Result<WebEvidence,WebError>. WebEvidence Clone Copy Debug Eq PartialEq pub instructions:usize, assignments:usize, register_reads:usize, relation_pairs:usize, blocks:usize. WebError Clone Debug Eq PartialEq plus Display/Error, concrete categories can be chosen; bounded-unavailable distinct from shape/invalid correspondence. Keep original entry/length/address/size/control kinds/targets and exact paired expression structure except Reg leaves and Reg destinations. Candidate register_count>= original. Unreachable instructions strict equality. Analyze definite read correspondence pairs (oldReg,newReg) via MUST/intersection fixed point: domain only paired-read pairs plus destination pairs; at entry pair true iff old==new (all extra input registers arbitrary poison); seed intersect predecessor facts on entry backedges. Others start TOP. A successful Reg assignment olddest=o,newdest=n kills facts with source=o or destination=n, generates pair(o,n). Reads checked BEFORE writes; stores address and RHS require same current facts; control after assignments. First compute fixpoint without rejecting intermediate facts, then check every read against final local facts. This inductive relation certifies return/memory/fault/trace under arbitrary fresh initial values, NOT final original register-file equality. No code/import/helper from web builder; no solver/deps. Whole-input iterative depth/count validation before cloning/recursion/derived Eq, bound pairs*blocks/state/work/iterations, whole failure with no partial evidence. Tests manually constructed valid and invalid candidates incl wrong register, missing entry seed, clobber of future input, partial-store faults, shape/width/targets mismatches, loop diamonds and resource bounds.
contracts.parent: Integrate validated WebSplit into readable preparation, keeping original ReducedFunction parameters and original structure_evidence semantics. Add separate renaming evidence and display-AST evidence for web IR, do not silently retarget original certificate. Candidate budget/validation/structure failure falls back to original pipeline. Widths/views/read/LocalPlan all consume same chosen IR. No Node-origin retrofit; recover display structure against chosen renamed Program. Add source fixture +native ABI/fault regression, before/after same objects and full checks. May conservatively disable candidate when rendering cannot retain complete old support.

criteria: independent poisoned replay and bounded fallback
bad candidates rejected with no universal proof inflation

stop: One bounded register-web split pass and independent validator, C integration with complete fallback, concrete reused-register fixture + native checks, measured output, local commits. No loop-unroll reversal, memory SSA or source-variable naming proof.

adaptive_decision.trigger: Static reviewer found sparse near-usizeMAX candidate consumes final C temporary IDs, losing old rendering availability.
adaptive_decision.decision: Prepared/rendered web candidate is optional through final C emission: on normalization/sequence error retry source path exactly once and preserve separate RenderingFallback error cause. Native regression bothstyles/O0/O2.
